tha-ap32:1.1: Khomadāyaka.] *Nagare Bandhumati*yā ahosiṃ vāṇijo tadā / ten' eva dāraṃ posemi ropemi bījasampadaṃ. // //
tha-ap32:2.1: Rathiyaṃ paṭipannassa Vipassissa mahesino / ekaṃ khomaṃ mayā dinnaṃ kusalatthāya satthuno. // //
tha-ap32:3.1: Ekanavute ito kappe *yaṃ khomam adadiṃ tadā* / duggatiṃ nābhijānāmi khomadānass' idaṃ phalaṃ. // //
tha-ap32:4.1: Sattavīse ito kappe eko Sindhavasandano / sattaratanasampanno cātuddīpamhi issaro. // //
tha-ap32:5.1: Paṭisambhidā catasso vimokhā pi ca aṭṭh' ime / chaḍabhiññā sacchikatā kataṃ Buddhassa sāsanan ti. // //
tha-ap32:6.1: Itthaṃ sudaṃ āyasmā Khomadāyako thero imā gāthāyo abhāsitthā ti.
tha-ap32:9.1: Subhūti Upavāno ca Saraṇo Sīlagā*hako Annasaṃsāvako Dhūpo* Puḷino Uttiyena ca.
tha-ap32:10.1: Añjalī Khomadāyī ca das' eva tatiye gaṇe pañcāsītisataṃ vuttā gāthāyo sabbapiṇḍitā.
